description: Transcribe the actual audio of a YouTube, TikTok or Instagram video with Whisper large-v3. Not caption scraping: the audio is downloaded and run through speech recognition, so it works on videos with no subtitles, in any language, and on TikTok and Instagram where no caption track exists at all. Extraction runs from a real residential IP, reaching sources that refuse datacenter ranges. Returns full text plus sentence-level timestamps. — $0.020000/call, paid per request via x402 (USDC). Use when asked: "transcribe this youtube video", "get the transcript of this tiktok", "speech to text from a video URL".
name: transcribe
